findings.summary: The manifest's artifacts line cites head-newtest.log as '4 passed in 1.73s locally', but that file reads '1 failed in 2.45s' and its mtime (23:22) precedes the fix commit 4d42346e22 (23:30), so it ran an earlier draft of the test; no log under the run directory records the final test passing at head, and neither gate arm (gate-base.log, gate-head.log) includes tests/test_a_full_disk_is_not_a_test_failure.py (grep count 0 in both). The green result is therefore claimed and not recorded. An independent re-run of that single test at 996de76011 gives '4 passed in 1.70s', so the deliverable is sound and the defect is in the record: cite a real green log and add the test to an arm, or correct the artifacts line.

_STORAGE_FAILURE matches storage phrases case-insensitively against every line of an arm's output, so a genuine test failure whose own message contains 'no space left on device' or 'ENOSPC' would be read as the node's storage failure, discarding real failure ids and triggering a retry that excludes a healthy node; scope the match to pytest's setup-error line shape so a delivery's own assertion text cannot be mistaken for the node's disk.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_full_disk_is_not_a_test_failure.py:155-207 asserts the retry record, node naming, empty real set and --exclude in the submitted argv, each of which reddens if the storage branch is removed; the base negative control records 4 failed.
justifications.evidence: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py is measured by two on-disk gate arms with identical 11-failure sets, but tests/test_a_full_disk_is_not_a_test_failure.py is absent from both arm commands and its only cited local log is a stale red run.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:566 reuses socket.gethostname as the rest of reckon/crew does, and the added names (storage_failure, arm_node, exclude_nodes) describe mechanism with no plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:1843 breaks out of the judged-arm loop on arm.storage_failure, names the node and reports no test ids, which is the goal verbatim.
justifications.reuse: No existing storage-failure parser exists under reckon/ (grep for 'no space left on device', 'ENOSPC', 'numbered dir with prefix' finds none), and exclude_nodes extends the existing partition_submission/_partition_runner owners rather than forking them.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in diff d7f54a14..996de760 is one of the declared write paths, and the two later commits are docs-only.

verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against d7f54a14: 4d42346e22 adds storage_failure/arm_node, Arm.node/storage_failure, Measurement.storage_node/storage_retry, exclude_nodes plumbing and the _is_environmental branch; 5b013e015a makes the fixture name 18 distinct files; 12936c291a and 996de76011 add the evidence fragment. All inside scope.
verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_a_full_disk_is_not_a_test_failure.py; the file exists at head and passes 4/4 when run at 996de76011, but no gate log under the run directory records that pass (gate-base.log and gate-head.log each contain zero references to it) and the cited head-newtest.log shows the earlier draft failing.
verdicts.goal: The node goal is 'a full disk on the arm's node is not a test failure'; reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:1843 sets storage_node from the arm's own '# host:' line and suppresses its failure ids, delivering exactly that.
verdicts.manifest: Read; it reports 11 failed / 597 passed at both arms and names its gate logs, but its artifacts line misquotes head-newtest.log as a green run where the file reads '1 failed in 2.45s'.
verdicts.write_paths: The four changed paths -- the evidence fragment, reckon/crew/landing_measure.py, reckon/crew/queue_landing.py and tests/test_a_full_disk_is_not_a_test_failure.py -- are all inside the five declared write paths.
